summary: Amass Brands filed an 8-K to report a second amendment to a SAFE agreement with AFTERDREAM, Inc., increasing the purchase amount from $1,535,000 to $1,735,000 (additional $200,000 investment by Amass Brands) while the post-money valuation cap remains $7,500,000. The SAFE converts upon an equity financing, liquidity event, or dissolution event. This is a routine amendment to a financing instrument, not a special-situation category such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing discloses no price per share, premium, deal structure, or strategic review. It is merely a contractual modification without triggering event significance, thus classified as None.
